currentParagraphText: The Malefic Viper turned to look in the direction of the Mycotic Depths as he smiled. “A World Wonder that’s essentially a cave full of mushrooms. How could I resist paying such a wonderful place a visit? Almost makes me nostalgic thinking about it.”
